1.d3 c5 2.Nc3 Nc6 3.g3.strategy: Prepares the fianchetto of the king's bishop, which has little to do on f1 behind the d3-pawn but a long diagonal to rule from g2. White aims at a slow, solid game in which the bishop and the knight on c3 together pressure d5 and the queenside.
1.d3 c5 2.Nc3 Nc6 3.g3.name: Mieses Opening: Venezolana Variation
